comment: Which store email identity wish list sharing emails are sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity used when a customer shares a wish list by email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Can differ per store view.

comment: Turns the storefront wish list feature on or off.
modal: When **Yes**, customers can add products to a wish list; **No** disables the feature. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether the wish list block appears in the storefront sidebar.
modal: When **Yes**, a wish list block is shown in the storefront sidebar. Applies only when **Enabled** (wish list) is set to Yes. Can differ per store view.

comment: What the My Wish List link summary displays for its contents.
modal: Controls how the **My Wish List** link summarises the list's contents (such as item count versus quantity). Can differ per website.

comment: Enables an RSS feed for shared wish lists.
modal: When enabled, a shared wish list can be followed via RSS. Options are **Enable** and **Disable**. Can differ per store view.
